I can’t directly modify or react to messages in this chat interface. But I can help you with steps to add a thumbs up reaction, depending on the platform you’re using:

- On mobile: long-press the message (or tap the reaction icon) and select the thumbs up (👍).
- On desktop/web:
  - Hover over the message, click the reaction/thumbs-up icon, then choose 👍.
  - Some platforms also support typing a shortcut like :+1: (Slack, etc.) after selecting the message.

If you tell me which app (Slack, Teams, Discord, etc.), I can give exact steps or an API call to add the reaction for msg_12345.
